name: Extreme Reactors

source.read: cloned at the branch; config in src/main/java/it/zerono/mods/extremereactors/config, items in src/main/resources/assets/bigreactors/lang/en_us.json

unverified: Reactor and turbine output depends on multiblock layout, so no single FE/t is given. Requires ZeroCore. Confirm ore worldgen is actually off in Verdant/Elysian (data/bigreactors/worldgen ships yellorite, anglesite and benitoite ores).

tuning.effect: Global and per-type output multipliers (0.005 to 100) and fuel usage
Gate tiers (Basic vs Reinforced) via KubeJS

compat.what: Powah dry ice is listed in a coolant tag (1 entry); no code support

items.name: Reactor (Basic / Reinforced)
items.input: Yellorium / blutonium fuel rods, optional coolant (steam mode feeds a turbine)
items.notes: Overlaps Powah Reactor and Mekanism Fission. Fuel needs yellorite ore, which Verdant/Elysian disable; check the source path.

scaling.formula: output scales with fuel rod count and height; global reactorPowerProductionMultiplier (default 1.0)
scaling.note: Size cap maxReactorSize 32 x maxReactorHeight 48; unverified formula detail

scaling.formula: output scales with blades, coils and fluid flow; global turbinePowerProductionMultiplier (default 1.0)
scaling.note: Size cap 32 x 32; unverified formula detail

items.name: Energy Core
items.notes: Multiblock battery, the closest match to the Ender IO capacitor bank the pack wants. Confirm size, capacity and recipe.

items.name: Extreme Wrench
items.notes: Another wrench: overlaps Create, Mekanism (Configurator), Morph-o-Tool and Metalworks tools. Morph-o-Tool test candidate.
